verdict.rationale: Superhuman offers team-collaboration features like shared read statuses, reply indicators, team scheduling, @mention comments, and shared snippets, which support visibility and coordination among teammates, but there is no evidence of an explicit 'assign conversation to teammate' feature or rule-based mail routing engine that establishes formal ownership. missing for 10: explicit conversation assignment feature, rule-based inbox routing/ownership assignment, evidence of team-lead configuring routing rules.
